data.narrative:
EX-Fusion is a Series A nuclear energy company founded by Kazuki Matsuo, Shinsuke Fujioka, and Yoshitaka Mori, having raised $37M to date. Valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 11 firms across the nuclear energy sector: 3 public equities (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private companies including Fuse Energy, Valar Atomics, X-Energy, Oklo, and Nano Nuclear Energy.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis, using the $37M raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A-to-next-stage advancement, implies a $74M valuation. Peer-median analysis across three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables yields a median valuation of $808M, with observed range of $200M (Fuse Energy, Series A) to $6.0B (Valar Atomics, Series B). The peer-min floor stands at $200M.

Triangulation across both methods produces a range of $63M (low) to $929M (high), with a median of $441M. Stage-progression alone underpins the lower bound; peer-median analysis anchors the center and upper range. Key uncertainties include EX-Fusion's competitive positioning within the peer set, the materiality of unreported operational or technical milestones relative to comparables, and sector-wide capital intensity dynamics that may compress or expand valuation multiples.
